events.summary: Hands-on foundational workshop exploring AWS core services, Serverless architecture, and building your first cloud app on AWS.
events.description_md:
### Welcome to AWS Cloud Discovery Day!

This foundational, student-focused technical session is curated to introduce you to the world of cloud computing using Amazon Web Services (AWS). Whether you are completely new to cloud or want to sharpen your architectural intuition, this session is tailored for you.

#### What You Will Learn:
- **Cloud Computing Essentials:** Understanding regions, availability zones, and core infrastructure.
- **Compute & Serverless:** Exploring AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and running code without managing servers.
- **Database & Storage:** Storing application data securely with Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB.
- **Hands-on Guided Lab:** Deploying a live serverless REST API from scratch.
- **Career Pathways & Certifications:** Navigating AWS Cloud Practitioner and Solutions Architect certifications.

#### Who Should Attend:
- Any student from Noida International University (all branches/years welcome) aged 18+.
- Aspiring cloud architects, backend engineers, and data enthusiasts.

site_settings.aboutDescription:
The AWS Student Builder Group at Noida International University is a student-led, student-driven academic community dedicated to learning, building, and innovating with Amazon Web Services.

We bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world industry demands. Through hands-on AWS projects, architectural workshops, and peer mentorship, our members gain deep technical proficiency alongside strategic business acumen.

Whether you are passionate about cloud architecture, cybersecurity, generative AI, machine learning, robotics, or business transformation, this community provides the collaborative launchpad to turn concepts into production cloud systems.
